description: Read Markdown in a dedicated reader tab with Japanese typography: fixed line length, Japanese and Latin font pairing, comfortable line height, and punctuation spacing.
config.theme: Color theme of the reader. High-contrast VS Code themes always use the VS Code colors.
config.theme.vscode: Follow the colors of the current VS Code theme.
config.layout.maxWidth: Maximum width of the text in pixels. 0 means no limit.
config.layout.align: Where to place the text when the window is wider than the maximum width.
config.layout.padding: Horizontal padding around the text in pixels.
config.font.family: Font family for the text, in CSS font-family syntax. Put Latin fonts first and Japanese fonts after them so each script uses its own font. Bundled Japanese fonts: "Noto Sans JP" and "BIZ UDPGothic".
config.font.codeFamily: Font family for code. Leave empty to use a Japanese monospace font whose Latin and Japanese widths are exactly 1:2 (BIZ UDGothic, Osaka-Mono, Noto Sans Mono CJK JP), with box-drawing characters narrowed to half width, so text diagrams line up even when they contain Japanese.
config.font.size: Font size of the text in pixels.
config.font.lineHeight: Line height of the text, as a multiple of the font size.
config.customCss: Path to a CSS file loaded after the theme. Absolute, or starting with ${workspaceFolder}. Override any --yomu-* variable or rule.
config.focusMode: Focus mode: dim everything except the blocks you are reading (those between 30% and 55% down the screen). Toggle it with "Yomu: Toggle Focus Mode".
config.code.foldLines: Fold code blocks longer than this many lines. A button shows the rest. 0 never folds.
viewsWelcome.outline:
Open a Markdown file in the Yomu reader to see its headings here.
[Open in Reader](command:yomu.openInReader)
config.outline.revealOnOpen: Open the Yomu Outline view when you open a reader tab. The reader keeps the keyboard focus. Off by default, because it switches the side bar away from what you were looking at.
viewsWelcome.history: Documents you read in the Yomu reader appear here, with how far you have read. Click one to continue where you left off.
